summary: Iteration 25 (Stitches) — validated per-user SMTP config CRUD, admin clear endpoints (SMTP/SFU/RTC), recurring meetings (weekly expansion & none), plus frontend flows: dashboard 'This week' widget, Meetings recurrence selector/badge, Settings my-smtp save+clear, Admin Meetings tab clear-credential buttons. All backend and frontend checks passed.
critical_code_review_comments: meetings.py is ~430 lines and mixes meetings CRUD, TURN, SFU/LiveKit and SMTP settings. Consider splitting into meetings.py, rtc_config.py, sfu_config.py and smtp_config.py routers for maintainability (>700-line risk as features grow).
PUT /api/me/smtp-config casts int(body.get('port') or 587) with no try/except; sending non-numeric port would 500. Wrap in try/except or use Pydantic model.

_expand_occurrences returns up to 60 occurrences and upcoming_meetings caps items[:50] after sort. For workspaces with many recurring meetings this can hide near-term meetings behind far-future weekly ones from other rooms. Consider per-meeting cap first, then global sort/slice.

GET /api/admin/smtp-config and /api/admin/sfu-config fall back to env vars (SMTP_HOST, LIVEKIT_URL) after DELETE, so the 'cleared' UI can still show env-provided values. Tests accept both, but the UX may be confusing — consider making DELETE clear the env fallback in the response too.
WeekCalendar appends 'Z' to scheduled_at when constructing Date but backend already stores naive UTC — this convention is consistent but brittle; consider returning ISO 8601 with Z from the API.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ prefixed meetings during backend & UI tests (TEST_weekly_meet, TEST_once_meet, TEST_UI_weekly). Also PUT then DELETE on demo user's SMTP and admin SMTP/SFU/RTC configs — end state: demo user's SMTP cleared, admin SMTP/SFU/TURN cleared. Test meetings persist in DB but are prefixed TEST_ for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints /api/me/smtp-config (GET/PUT/DELETE), /api/admin/{smtp,sfu,rtc}-config DELETE, and /api/meetings with recurrence in {none,daily,weekly} all confirmed working via pytest. UI: dashboard week-calendar-widget renders 7 day cells with meeting chips; /meetings modal has recurrence-none/daily/weekly and creates meetings that appear with data-testid=recurrence-badge (weekly meeting produced 10 expanded rows in Upcoming). Settings /settings my-smtp-section save+clear works; Admin /admin -> Meetings tab clear-turn-btn/clear-sfu-btn/clear-smtp-btn show success toast without errors. Note: after DELETE admin configs, GET falls back to env-var defaults when set; my tests accept either empty string or the env default.
